value.rationale: The target-location partition is a natural complete classification of a physical two-community search process, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Its strictly signed all-rate effects and exact n/(m+n) maximal benefit quantify a robust bottleneck-search dichotomy that global numerical MFPT does not report. The theorem works for all clique sizes and all reset rates.
